disable.docs: This action turns off the Ethernet interface on demand.

enable.docs: This action turns on the Ethernet interface on demand.

connected.docs: This [Condition](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-conditions) checks if the device currently has an Ethernet connection.

enabled.docs: This [Condition](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-conditions) checks if the Ethernet interface is currently enabled.

domain.docs:
**string**: Set the domain of the node hostname used for uploading. For example, if it's set to `.local`, all uploads will be sent to `<HOSTNAME>.local`. Defaults to `.local`.

*See also: [Ethernet Component](https://esphome.io/components/ethernet#configuration-variables)*

enable_on_boot.docs:
**boolean**: If enabled, the Ethernet interface will be enabled on boot. Defaults to `true`.

*See also: [Ethernet Component](https://esphome.io/components/ethernet#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID used for code generation.

*See also: [Ethernet Component](https://esphome.io/components/ethernet#configuration-variables)*

mac_address.docs:
**MAC Address**: Set the MAC address of the ethernet interface.

*See also: [Ethernet Component](https://esphome.io/components/ethernet#configuration-variables)*

dns1.docs:
**IPv4 address**: The main DNS server to use.

*See also: [Ethernet Component](https://esphome.io/components/ethernet#configuration-variables)*

dns2.docs:
**IPv4 address**: The backup DNS server to use.

*See also: [Ethernet Component](https://esphome.io/components/ethernet#configuration-variables)*

gateway.docs:
**IPv4 address**: The gateway of the local network.

*See also: [Ethernet Component](https://esphome.io/components/ethernet#configuration-variables)*

static_ip.docs:
**IPv4 address**: The static IP of your node.

*See also: [Ethernet Component](https://esphome.io/components/ethernet#configuration-variables)*

subnet.docs:
**IPv4 address**: The subnet of the local network.

*See also: [Ethernet Component](https://esphome.io/components/ethernet#configuration-variables)*

manual_ip.docs:
Manually configure the static IP of the node.

*See also: [Ethernet Component](https://esphome.io/components/ethernet#configuration-variables)*

on_connect.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An action to be performed when a connection is established.

*See also: [Ethernet Component](https://esphome.io/components/ethernet#configuration-variables)*

on_disconnect.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An action to be performed when the connection is dropped.

*See also: [Ethernet Component](https://esphome.io/components/ethernet#configuration-variables)*

use_address.docs:
**string**: Manually override what address to use to connect to the ESP. Defaults to auto-generated value. For example, if you have changed your static IP and want to flash OTA to the previously configured IP address.

*See also: [Ethernet Component](https://esphome.io/components/ethernet#configuration-variables)*

clock_speed.docs:
**float**: The SPI clock speed. ESP32 only. Any frequency between `8MHz` and `80MHz` is allowed, but the nearest integer division of `80MHz` is used, i.e. `16MHz` (`80MHz` / 5) is used when `15MHz` is configured. Default: `26.67MHz`.

*See also: [Ethernet Component](https://esphome.io/components/ethernet#configuration-variables)*

cs_pin.docs:
**[Pin](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin)**: The SPI chip select pin.

*See also: [Ethernet Component](https://esphome.io/components/ethernet#configuration-variables)*

interface.docs:
**string**: Controls which ESP-IDF SPI implementation should be used. Value may be either `spi2` or `spi3`.

*See also: [Ethernet Component](https://esphome.io/components/ethernet#configuration-variables)*

interrupt_pin.docs:
**[Pin](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin)**: The interrupt pin. This variable is **required** for older frameworks. See below.

*See also: [Ethernet Component](https://esphome.io/components/ethernet#configuration-variables)*

polling_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: If `interrupt_pin` is not set, set the time interval for periodic polling. Minimum is 1ms; defaults to 10ms. ESP32 only. Older frameworks may not support this variable. See below for details.

*See also: [Ethernet Component](https://esphome.io/components/ethernet#configuration-variables)*

mdc_pin.docs:
**[Pin](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin)**: The MDC pin. On the ESP32-S31 this is `GPIO5`.

*See also: [Ethernet Component](https://esphome.io/components/ethernet#configuration-variables)*

mdio_pin.docs:
**[Pin](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin)**: The MDIO pin. On the ESP32-S31 this is `GPIO6`.

*See also: [Ethernet Component](https://esphome.io/components/ethernet#configuration-variables)*

phy_addr.docs:
**int**: The PHY address of the Ethernet controller. Defaults to `0`.

*See also: [Ethernet Component](https://esphome.io/components/ethernet#configuration-variables)*

power_pin.docs:
**[Pin](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin)**: The PHY reset/power pin. On the ESP32-S31 this is `GPIO7`. Recommended so the PHY is reset cleanly at startup.

*See also: [Ethernet Component](https://esphome.io/components/ethernet#configuration-variables)*

phy_registers.docs:
**mapping**: Arbitrary PHY register values to set after Ethernet initialization, with the same `address`/`value`/`page_id` sub-options as the [RMII configuration variables](https://esphome.io/components/ethernet#rmii-configuration-variables) above.

*See also: [Ethernet Component](https://esphome.io/components/ethernet#configuration-variables)*

*See also: [Ethernet Component](https://esphome.io/components/ethernet#configuration-variables)*

mdio_pin.docs:
**[Pin](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin)**: The MDIO pin of the board. Usually this is `GPIO18`.

*See also: [Ethernet Component](https://esphome.io/components/ethernet#configuration-variables)*

phy_addr.docs:
**int**: The PHY addr type of the Ethernet controller. Defaults to 0.

*See also: [Ethernet Component](https://esphome.io/components/ethernet#configuration-variables)*

phy_registers.docs:
**mapping**: Arbitrary PHY register values to set after Ethernet initialization.

*See also: [Ethernet Component](https://esphome.io/components/ethernet#configuration-variables)*

power_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The pin controlling the power/reset status of the Ethernet controller. Leave unspecified for no power pin (default).

*See also: [Ethernet Component](https://esphome.io/components/ethernet#configuration-variables)*

address.docs:
**hex**: The register address as a hex number (e.g. `0x10` for address 16)

*See also: [Ethernet Component](https://esphome.io/components/ethernet#configuration-variables)*

page_id.docs:
**hex**: (RTL8201 only) Register page number to select before writing (e.g. `0x07` for page 7)

*See also: [Ethernet Component](https://esphome.io/components/ethernet#configuration-variables)*

value.docs:
**hex**: The value of the register to set as a hex number (e.g. `0x1FFA`  )

*See also: [Ethernet Component](https://esphome.io/components/ethernet#configuration-variables)*
